summary_patient: HIGH RISK: Your blood sugar is dangerously close to a critical threshold, and your LDL cholesterol is significantly elevated. Combined with mild kidney strain, these findings require urgent clinical attention within 24 hours.
summary_doctor: HIGH-RISK METABOLIC PANEL: Near-critical hyperglycaemia (Glucose 241 mg/dL), concurrent severe dyslipidaemia (LDL-C 178 mg/dL), early diabetic nephropathy signal (Creatinine 1.5 mg/dL, CKD Stage 2 risk). Full endocrinological workup with OGTT, HbA1c, and renal clearance studies recommended urgently.

diet: Strict elimination of all simple sugars and white flour products
DASH diet protocol — low salt, high fiber, heart-protective fats
lifestyle: Check fasting blood glucose every morning
Begin moderate walking program — 20 mins twice daily
Reduce all NSAID and OTC painkiller use to protect kidneys
